items.question: What is the minimum age to apply for a driver's licence under the UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 14 of 2024 on Traffic Regulation?
items.gold: Applicants must be at least 17 years old.
items.fact: Driver licence applicants must be at least 17 years old

items.question: Under the UAE weights and dimensions regulations for heavy vehicles, above what total weight in tonnes are heavy vehicles banned from roads from 2024?
items.gold: Heavy vehicles with a total weight exceeding 65 tonnes are banned from plying the roads from 2024.
items.fact: Heavy vehicles over 65 tonnes banned from UAE roads from 2024
